about: Front ends for hearing the name while the duck turns its own body (2026-11-01). Test clips: oww/make_turn_mixes.py (8 held-out home calls of calls_200910 + held-out 10/31 turn noise; m6 = live post-glue call level, p0, p6 = noise +0/+6 dB; clean; noise alone). Whole-motion false peaks: 48 motion intervals, 290 s (life log, speech not masked). Scorer oww/score_mixes.py, threshold 0.7.
noise_shape: 300-1000 Hz: turn frames median -61.3 dB vs standing -62.1, p90 -53.5; a 2 m call median -58.9, p90 -53.0. The noise is footstep/servo impacts: 10 % of 20 ms frames carry 70 % of the energy; flatness 0.8, no fixed tones.

v3.motion_peak_at: 10-31 20:21:57 (inside the held-out turn where a voiced two-syllable word sits; probably a real call)

deepfilternet3_no_pregain.note: the quiet 2 m call (-62 dB) is suppressed as noise: SNR -8.4 -> +15.7 dB but the call itself falls 15 dB

cost: DeepFilterNet3 (PyTorch, Mac mini M-series, 1 thread): 0.04 x real time per channel. A7Z cost not measured (offline since 10/31 20:45).
decision: Use DeepFilterNet3 with +30 dB pre-gain on each ear only while the duck's own body turns; spotter stays v4 (v5 rejected: 7 false wakes on held-out life talk, 10 peaks on motion audio). Next: an A7Z runtime (ONNX/tract streaming) and its CPU cost while the brain runs.
